spec_match.rationale: Uses the windowfeatures content attribute on a, area and form with rel governing the opener, implied _blank, and named-frame precedence, mirroring declarative-windowfeatures.tentative.html; reflection lab mirrors its IDL test.

interactive.rationale: Reflection lab (element select, value input, two directions) plus seven real links/area/form that open the report pane and log results.

edge_cases.rationale: Default rel (noopener) vs rel=opener, no-target link (legacy navigates this tab, labelled up-front), existing named iframe winning, area without windowfeatures as control.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus, explainer Declarative form section and the WPT.

conformance.rationale: Suite asserts IDL presence on all three elements and both reflection directions; implied-target behaviour recorded as manual.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chrome for Testing 153 via Playwright at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch: every control exercised, real popup windows opened and reported back; console clean (only font requests aborted when the opened panes were closed mid-load); no horizontal overflow; screenshots read. Reflection returns undefined / expando-only on 153 as expected; links: rel=opener → opener present, default → null via BroadcastChannel, form → opener present, named link loaded into the iframe, no-target link navigated this tab (legacy behaviour).

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts both reflection directions against API detection and that the opener follows rel.

design_system.rationale: Variables for all UI; the image-map picture is an SVG image (its fills are image content, not CSS text/background).

accessibility.rationale: Links have descriptive text, areas and the map image have alt text, iframe has a title, results go to a role=log region.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No overflow at 360px; the 320px map image scales with max-inline-size.

openQuestions.title: Capture the split-aware branch on a WindowOpenSplitTab-enabled Chrome
openQuestions.detail: This container's Chrome for Testing 153 predates the feature (windowFeatures absent even with --enable-experimental-web-platform-features), so only the legacy branch executed. Re-run on Canary with --enable-blink-features=WindowOpenSplitTab in a wide headed window and confirm a real split appears and the pane reports locationbar.visible=true for a bare "split".

openQuestions.title: Inspect the accessibility tree with chrome-devtools-mcp
openQuestions.detail: Verified in headless Chrome via Playwright (no chrome-devtools-mcp in the cloud routine). Names/roles were set with native elements but the AX tree was not inspected.

openQuestions.title: Area click coverage
openQuestions.detail: Area activation was driven by clicking the image map coordinates; verify keyboard activation of the area in the AX tree with DevTools MCP.

guidanceConsulted.query: window.open popup blocking user activation open link new tab
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Avoid blocking/unexpected popups; open new views only from an explicit user action.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: window.open() runs only inside click handlers (transient activation); a null handle is reported as blocked, never as success; the explainer's popup=0 guard is the default so legacy engines get a tab, not a popup.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible toggle button group responsive control panel no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native labelled form controls (fieldset/legend, label-wrapped checkboxes/radios, select) rather than custom widgets; keep controls in wrapping grids.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All controls are native inputs/selects/buttons with labels or fieldset legends, laid out in repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 14-15rem), 1fr)) grids; targets are min 44px.

guidanceConsulted.query: live region status announcements for async results
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce asynchronous results through a single polite status/log region; do not move focus.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each page has one role=status (or role=log) readout updated with textContent when the opened pane reports back; focus is never stolen.

guidanceConsulted.query: rel noopener opener window.open security postMessage cross window
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Validate cross-window messages by exact origin and expected source window; reject the opaque "null" origin; never use string prefix checks.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every message listener checks ev.origin === location.origin, rejects "null", and (where a handle exists) ev.source === handle; postMessage always passes location.origin as targetOrigin. Origin.from() is not used because exact same-origin string equality after rejecting "null" is the guide's documented fallback and needs no extra support check.

summary: Declarative surface verified on the legacy path: the attribute is inert, which is exactly the graceful degradation the explainer promises.
